title: Cardinality bound for block coverage
statement: Let $\Gamma$ and $Q$ be types, let $k$ be a natural number, let $x$ be a finite input over $\Gamma$, and let $M$ be a $k$-work-tape machine with state type $Q$. For any configuration $c$, work-tape index $i$, and natural numbers $N,t$, the union of the block intervals indexed by the tape-head positions visited from $c$ through step $t$ has cardinality at most $(N+1)$ times the number of distinct positions visited, plus one.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a multi-tape machine with $k$ work tapes and states in $Q$
